units.source_text: 我得了信，惦念起来，便去访问。

en.t: When I received her letter, I grew concerned and went to visit her.

units.source_text: 她照例殷勤接待，只是面带愁容。

en.t: As usual, she received me warmly, but her face was clouded with sorrow.

units.source_text: 我望望那霜露交加的萧条庭院，觉得情景凄凉，

en.t: I looked out at the desolate garden, heavy with frost and dew, and felt that the scene was bleak and mournful,
no less sorrowful than the plaintive cries of the insects,

units.source_text: 教人联想起古昔的哀情小说来。

en.t: calling to mind the tragic love stories of old.
So I answered her with a poem:
